title: Draft
description: A card being made or edited in the drawer (§8). Lives in server memory only and is gone on DELETE, save or restart: conversations and unsaved drafts are never stored (§6).

card_id.description: The card being edited; null for a new card.

notes.description: Source notes as the user and the source role left them.

sentences.description: notes split by the server (§15); evidence, highlights and changed sentences use these 0-based indexes.

pinned.description: Field paths kept from the saved card when the card is generated again.

generated.description: The last generated card, not saved yet; null before 카드 생성.
